info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices API provides access to a comprehensive list of devices associated with active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve device information, empowering service providers and developers to effectively manage streaming capabilities. Typical consumers include application developers integrating streaming services, customer support representatives addressing user inquiries, and system administrators overseeing subscription management. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance user experience through better insight into device usage and subscription details.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices under a subscription.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all devices associated with a specific subscription. It returns detailed information about each device, helping in managing subscriptions effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve devices under specified subscriptions. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters in the schema for proper access.
